preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases, an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(line) and N >= 1 and N <= 100000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is the number of matches, an integer between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(goals) == N for N, goals in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N goal counts, one per match.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= int(g) <= 1000000 for g in goals) for goals in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]])
preconditions.description: Each goal count is an integer between 0 and 1000000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == str(max(0, max(gj - gi for i, gi in enumerate(goals) for j in range(i + 1, len(goals)) if gj > gi))) or stdout_line.strip() == 'UNFIT' for goals, stdout_line in zip([line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output the maximum goal difference (gj - gi) where j > i and gj > gi, or 'UNFIT' if no such pair exists.
